sources.text: We’ve been recommended The Consulate and haven’t had the chance to come until now, and I wish we had come sooner! The food was amazing, with a mix of interesting and classic foods. Bibi, our server, was lovely, thoughtful, and recommended some great dishes. We’ll be back!

Restaurantji diners rate it 4.6 828 ratings and were Blown away by interior design, topped with finger-licking food, friendly service. It suits a polished but easy neighborhood meal.

description.value: The Consulate UWS is a French brasserie at 519 Columbus Avenue New York, NY 10024. It sits on the corner of Columbus Avenue and West 85th Street near Central Park. The restaurant lists Happy Hour Monday – Friday: 3:30 – 6:30 PM, and brunch on weekends. OpenTable diners rate The Consulate UWS 4.5 from 528 reviews. Restaurantji diners call it a nice casual/not too casual joint that is great for Sunday supper.

itineraryNote: The Consulate UWS: a stylish French brasserie on Columbus Avenue; come for weekday happy hour or a relaxed Sunday supper.
review1: The Consulate impresses with its interior design, generous food, friendly service and well-crafted cocktails, according to many diners. Most of the review set points the same way on this.
review2: Diners describe a comfortable middle ground between casual and dressy that suits relaxed weekend dinners on the Upper West Side.
review3: Individual servers are praised by name, and warm, attentive service is a recurring reason guests return. Several separate reviews echo this point.
review4: Diners enjoy the mix of interesting and classic dishes and say they wish they had visited sooner, with thoughtful recommendations from staff.
